technical-summary: The Radiance CI build restored a ccache whose size limit (twice the previous build's touched bytes) was already reached, so every new object evicted a not-yet-used entry; the heavy libr3 HIP units, built late, then missed (86% hits, 35 minutes against 97% and 7). The build now runs with the limit lifted and the existing post-build trim applies the limit.
user-summary-candidate: Faster pull-request CI builds: the compiler cache no longer evicts entries the build still needs.
